Today's context has a score: 17 of 26 signed questions, 65%, known to within 46% to 81%. It passes 8 of
8 where the answer is in a statement and 6 of 6 where it is in a sourced entry, and 1 of 6 where an
entry written under eow-fin-07 says otherwise. Removing the eighth entry fixed 0 and broke 2: 15 of 26.
